speak.title: Role-play: should an old case stay open?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: a friend who thinks the case should stay open
a.text: You read about a very old case. Explain why you think the police should keep investigating. Ask your friend two questions about what they think.

b.role: a friend who thinks the money should be used elsewhere
b.text: You think police time and money should go to newer cases. Explain your view politely. Ask your friend what could still be found after so many years.

phrases: I think the police should keep trying.
I see what you mean, but it's been a long time.
What could they still find after all these years?
The family deserves an answer, don't you think?
I'd rather they spent the money on new cases.
Maybe we can agree on one thing.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you agree, and what helped you decide?
